notes: workcell_live_002 PARTIAL: the sever verdict FAIL is the expected evaluator output for a deliberate partial cut; the declared rule class is PARTIAL_CUT_ACCEPTED.

C5_live_trim_rho10_001 reference: class CUTTING_FAILURE is an artefact of applying the Phase E classifier to the C5 protocol (--stop-after-phase WITHDRAW); its recorded verdict is PASS and it is not a failure.

Test C chip particles below the board top: chip-p1 particles 46445/46572 (reference z 24.5 mm) passed through the cut substrate (conflicting digits decouple in TLMPM) to -0.597 mm and end embedded in the substrate (local z ~7 mm); chip-p0 particles 20088/20796 touched the board past the +x bar end (-0.08 mm transiently, -0.05 mm at the end). Final chips: p0 and p2 past the +x bar end on the board, p1 on the bar top at x ~ +52 mm, 4 fragments (59 particles) on the bar top.
Test B measured-path C2 FAIL (-12.5 um tool_blade vs static_flat_board, contact_allowed): C2 uses the nominal grasp; the measured knife min was -0.03 um and the knife slipped 15 um in the hand.
Test B inferred board reaction 12.7 N is one control step at first board contact of cut 1 (finger z -11.6 N, knife arriving at ~20 mm/s); settled hold 0.35-1.45 N.
